dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I've seen you before...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: That is indeed so. I was on Grand Master Varka's expedition.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: It was only recently, as the conflict in Nod-Krai drew to a close, that I was finally able to return to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: All these years, the Church of Favonius has continued to function only through the diligence of our priests and sisters. Therefore, I intend to share as much of the load as I can from now on, so that everyone can rest more.
